message.connectiblechains.connectible_ch: Click on fences/walls to create a catenary!
config.connectiblechains.title: Connectible Chains Configs
config.connectiblechains.chainHangAmount: Affects how much the chain hangs.
Lower numbers equals more a bigger curve.
Collision will update on new chains or world loading.
config.connectiblechains.maxChainRange.t: Affects how long a chain can be.
config.connectiblechains.quality.tooltip: Affects the visual quality of the chain.
config.connectiblechains.showToolTip.too: Show tooltip over chain items that are compatible with this mod.
config.connectiblechains.showRangeWarnin: Display an action bar message when a chain is nearing its maximum length.
config.connectiblechains.collisionsEnabl: If disabled, chains will not have a collision box and entities can pass through them.
config.connectiblechains.hangingBlockCol: If enabled, blocks hung on a chain (such as lanterns) get their own collision box. Requires chain collisions to be enabled.
config.connectiblechains.debugDraw.toolt: If enabled, shows debug vectors and entity counts for chains. Typically used for development.
